newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arthuis sees 1996 French GDP growth at 1.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis sees 1996 French GDP growth at 1.3 pct.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis reaffirmed French GDP growth would be some 1.3 percent in 1996 and 2.3 percent in 1997.

"Globally, the trends are the same (in France and Germany). Growth in 1996 will be on average one percent, and in France it will be higher. We have the assumption that it will be 1.3 percent," Arthuis told the Franco-German summit.
"For 1997, our forecasts are identical. We have a forecast of 2.3 percent, and I heard my German colleague give a range of 2.0 to 2.5 percent," he said.
The French government in March revised down its official growth forecast for 1996 to 1.3 percent from 2.8 percent contained in the 1996 budget adopted last year.

Arthuis said earlier this month he was maintaining a forecast of 1.3 percent growth for 1996 and that the next budget, due to be unveiled on Wednesday, would assume growth rising to 2.3 percent in 1997.
